title: Verify ZtdMysqli behaves like native mysqli for common application APIs
question: Where does ZtdMysqli diverge from native mysqli for application code that was written against the extension (return values, result types, insert_id, multi_query, store_result, fromMysqli wrapping)?
next_action: Eight divergences reported (#483-#490) from SCN-mysqli-native-parity on PHP 8.1.34/8.5.8 with MySQL 8.0.46; transactions, bind_result, get_result and fromMysqli isolation matched native. Next: post the pending #471 execute_query comment (findings/FND-mysqli-query-return-type/comment-execute-query.md) when a token with issue-write access is available; cover async queries (MYSQLI_ASYNC/poll/reap_async_query), change_user/select_db/set_charset and get_warnings(); re-run the scenario when upstream responds to the issues.
done_when: Each chosen API has a native control and ZTD observation on a supported runtime; every confirmed divergence is reported upstream or linked to an existing issue.
